offering_description.value: Provides ocean freight and logistics for multinational charterers moving dry bulk commodities. It uses its own fleet and an in-house commercial platform to carry cargo on shipping routes worldwide.

quotes.quote: We are the largest U.S.-headquartered drybulk shipping company. Through our in-house commercial operating platform, we provide a full-service logistics solution for the transportation of commodities worldwide using a diversified fleet of modern, fuel-efficient vessels.

Since our inception Genco has developed a leading reputation as an owner of high-quality, modern tonnage that meets strict operational, safety, and environmental standards. Our unrelenting focus on achieving the highest industry standards has enabled us to earn the trust of leading multinational charterers.

quotes.quote: We are the largest U.S.-headquartered drybulk shipping company. Through our in-house commercial operating platform, we provide a full-service logistics solution for the transportation of commodities worldwide using a diversified fleet of modern, fuel-efficient vessels.

Genco Shipping & Trading Limited is a U.S.-based drybulk shipowner focused on the seaborne transportation of commodities globally. Headquartered in New York City, with offices in Singapore and Copenhagen, Genco Shipping runs a truly global 24-hour operation offering a full-service logistics platform to our customers around the world. Our wholly owned high quality, modern fleet of dry cargo vessels consists of the larger Newcastlemax and Capesize vessels, as well as the medium-sized Ultramax and Supramax vessels, enabling us to carry a wide range of cargoes, including iron ore, grain, steel products, bauxite, cement, nickel ore among other commodities, along worldwide shipping routes.

quotes.quote: Genco's Global Presence in New York, Copenhagen, Singapore and Chennai

Genco Shipping & Trading Limited is a U.S.-based drybulk shipowner focused on the seaborne transportation of commodities globally. Headquartered in New York City, with offices in Singapore and Copenhagen, Genco Shipping runs a truly global 24-hour operation offering a full-service logistics platform to our customers around the world. Our wholly owned high quality, modern fleet of dry cargo vessels consists of the larger Newcastlemax and Capesize vessels, as well as the medium-sized Ultramax and Supramax vessels, enabling us to carry a wide range of cargoes, including iron ore, grain, steel products, bauxite, cement, nickel ore among other commodities, along worldwide shipping routes.

As one of the largest drybulk shipping companies in the world, Genco recognizes the need to run a safe and responsible business built for the long-term. We regularly integrate Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) practices into our operational and strategic decision making. As such, we aim to meet and, if possible and appropriate for our business, exceed minimum compliance levels set forth in rules and regulations governing the maritime industry. Over the last several years, we have taken various steps to reduce our carbon footprint and improve the environment, which includes purchasing modern, fuel-efficient vessels while divesting of older less fuel-efficient tonnage, among other important investments made to our sizeable fleet. Download our ESG Sustainability Report for further detail regarding key initiatives executed by the Genco team.

Genco’s sizeable and leading drybulk platform, which consists of 44 vessels and a team of experienced and dedicated onshore and seaborne professionals, is instrumental in our ability to serve as an essential link in international trade. Consistent with our focus on meeting the exacting needs of customers, we draw upon our considerable internal commercial management to provide a full service logistics solution and through our joint venture, GS Shipmanagement Pte.
